reference: No connection all the way to your friend? A message can still move. Station A holds the message and waits for a contact. A travelling relay passes by and accepts the message. Later, the relay meets station B and hands it over. This is called store and forward. Delivery is delayed, and not guaranteed. But with compatible systems, a missing live route doesn't always mean the message is lost. Explore offline communication with Meshline.
